step: edit one question inline, uncheck one, 'Save 11 selected' creates the collection and saves 11 items

detail.message: Saved 11 questions to your collection. Open collection

step: edited text is what was stored; explanations get the 'From "<title>", <section>' suffix
'Open collection' opens the collection's flashcard (explore) view with the saved questions
My study guides lists both documents with progress ('3 of 7 sections generated · 11 questions saved'), Collection link and Continue
DB: the auto-created study guide collection has IsPublic=true and IsDiscoverable=false
UI: 'Anyone with the link can view' is on and 'List in Discover' is off on the new collection

switches.name: Anyone with the link can view

step: anonymous GET /collections/{id} -> 200 while link access is on
GET /collections/discover does NOT list the collection (IsDiscoverable=false)
Share dialog shows the link, Copy link and a rendered QR code

detail.dialogText: Share collection | Collection link | Copy link | Show QR code

step: turning on 'List in Discover' (UI) makes it appear in GET /collections/discover
UI: anonymous visitor's Discover tab lists the collection
turning link access off (UI) also turns Discover off; anonymous GET -> 404 and Discover hides it
with link access off the owner still gets 200 and another member gets 404
link access back on -> anonymous 200 again, still not in Discover
